text:
claire: FYI release blocked for sdk-go after a typegen regen. Two separate things popped up: the semver diff flagged a change and the publish step hit a 401 loop in CI. Opening thread to coordinate quick fixes.

claire: ```
$ ./scripts/release --package sdk-go
> typegen: regenerated models (openapi v1.50.0) -> changed export order and removed unused internal helper symbol
> build: ok
> npm-registry proxy -> publishing go package metadata
ERROR: unauthorized (401) while publishing to registry
Semver check: detected non-trivial dist diff -> missing changelog fragment for minor bump
```

ci-bot: pipeline publish-sdk job=8201 failed step=publish reason="401 + semver-guard" :robot_face:

omar: is the dist diff actually user-facing? i.e., did the public API change or is this an internal ordering/renaming?

claire: it's reorder + an internal helper rename. nothing that should affect consumers but our binary/dist hash check doesn't know that.

matt: for the auth side, logs show the ephemeral token was rotated by creds-rotation mid-job. our publish action retries fixed-interval 3x and doesn't attempt to refresh the token between attempts. that can cause a terminal 401 if rotation happens during the window. we should add token refresh+exponential backoff.

ivy: short-term unblock: add a tiny changelog fragment explaining why this is non-breaking and re-run with a fresh CI token. i'll do that now. longer-term we should canonicalize typegen output before diffing. filing ticket DEVX-1192.

ci-bot: job #8202 queued by ivy.

omar: small addition: let's add a lightweight test in onboarding that simulates registry token rotation and ensures the publish step doesn't fail permanently. new users stumble on this during sampleapp onboarding and it's a bad first impression.

matt: created PR patch to publish action: https://git.internal/pr/6321 1 uses retry util with exp backoff (base 300ms, max 5 attempts, jitter) and calls credentials.fetch() before each retry. assigning @omar for review.

omar: looking now. one comment about the jitter distribution; otherwise LGTM.

ci-bot: job #8202 started, step=publish -> invoking publish script

claire: publish hit a transient 401 on attempt 2 but token refresh + backoff allowed attempt 3 to succeed. changelog fragment satisfied semver-check. package published as @redwood-inference/sdk-go@0.6.4.

imy: (typo) ivy: smoke runs show sampleapp onboarding completed and no 401 loops. I'll add the onboarding token-rotation e2e (DEVX-1193).

matt: merged PR #6321 into main. Also added unit test that fakes token expiry and checks retry behavior. PR: https://git.internal/pr/6330

omar: opening RFC DEVX-RFC-42 to propose a typegen-normalizer that sorts exports and strips internal helper renames before computing diffs. @claire @ivy please review.

claire: closing loop: job #8202 succeeded, PR #6321 merged, RFC filed. thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @omar (RFC), @ivy (onboarding e2e), @matt (unit tests).
